sources.title: Transcribe Marathi Audio | WhisperAI Speech-to-Text
sources.snippet: Transcribe Marathi audio with WhisperAI WhisperAI transcribes Marathi (मराठी) audio for the around 85 million speakers who use the language across the Indian state of Maharashtra and surrounding areas. Built on OpenAI Whisper and tuned for the realities of Marathi speech, the service produces publication-grade transcripts in Devanagari (with some Marathi-specific conventions).
